name: Saoirse Nkemdirim-Voss
description: The most-licensed neural signature in Vantablack's catalog, Saoirse Nkemdirim-Voss is known for a quality audiences describe as 'the warmth behind the teeth' — a low-frequency emotional resonance that makes her characters feel like people you have always known. Born in the Milwaukee Stack to a Nigerian-Irish-Brazilian household, she signed an exclusive Vantablack contract at nineteen and has not worked outside their ecosystem since. Her contract is widely cited in labor rights discussions as a model of corporate capture.
cultural_impact: The phrase 'Nkemdirim warmth' entered M88 vernacular as shorthand for any media experience that feels deceptively intimate.
story_hooks: A journalist discovers Vantablack has been sublicensing her neural signature to third-party advertisers without her knowledge, embedding her emotional texture into product feeds she never agreed to.
She reaches out through an intermediary to an underground neural-feed director, wanting to make one film outside the corp — but the ask could void her contract and trigger a neural-signature seizure.
A Shelf pirate collective releases a feed claiming to contain her 'true' unpatented baseline — and it feels nothing like the Vantablack version.
